name: Rola
source:
Human class.
The biggest witchaholic in the whole academy, she knows more about witches than anybody else. Ask her a single question, and she's able to ramble for hours on the subject.
She can get rash whenever witches are concerned. She's often found sneaking into the library in search of more knowledge or peeking into the witch class's dormitory.
